title: Checkpoint: Echo Server Core
prompt: POSIX. Implement `int echo_serve(int lfd)` — accept ONE connection on the already-bound/listening socket lfd, echo every byte received back to the client until the client half-closes (recv returns 0), close the connection, and return 0 (-1 on accept failure). The tests build a loopback listener, run echo_serve on a thread, connect, send, verify the echo, and half-close.

tests.name: echo roundtrip
tests.hint: Every sent byte comes back: echo semantics over one loopback connection.

tests.name: empty stream tolerated
tests.hint: A client that says nothing and closes: the server sees EOF immediately and finishes cleanly.

tests.name: bad fd refused
tests.hint: accept on an invalid descriptor fails: -1, no crash.
